Oneliner

Covered with optical reflectors to investigate Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite decay characteristics.
Description

Covered with optical reflectors so that students using collimated laser telescopes can track the satellites to investigate Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite decay characteristics and provide data for future CubeSat constellation lifetime estimates.
